body:
#2614 r4: the fresh STRICT reviewer returned REQUEST CHANGES at 7eeea2e04e (unrecorded; grant expired). Full text is on the PR.
r3 B1-B3 are fixed and 8/8 spot mutants are killed behaviourally. Two NEW blockers:
- B1 FAIL-OPEN, reproduced: covered spec IDs resolve to the first requirement only, so an ID collision (BUG-1535) with an Operator-mode credential spec auto-released the hold.
- B2: the fresh-ID verdict-corpus check (line 411) is untested; a mutant survives all 129 tests.
Both are small. Your ruling said there is no round 5, so I need your ruling: fix-forward (an integrator-commissioned implementer, about 30 lines plus tests, then a fresh STRICT review), the factory, or close and re-scope. I am holding until you rule.
subject: #2614 r4 REQUEST CHANGES: 2 new blockers (1 fail-open), need ruling
